ge-hong.oneLineEn: Eastern Jin Daoist thinker and cultivation theorist, best known for the Baopuzi.

gemistos-plethon.oneLineEn: Late Byzantine Platonist whose Book of Laws and Florence role shaped the Italian Renaissance classical revival.

gong-zizhen.oneLineEn: Late Qing thinker-writer known for statecraft reform, individual spirit, and institutional critique.
keywordsEn: On Enlightened Rulers and Good Ministers

gregory-palamas.oneLineEn: Late Byzantine hesychast who framed Orthodox mystical experience via essence/energies distinction and the Triads.
keywordsEn: Triads in Defense of the Holy Hesychasts

gu-yanwu.oneLineEn: Ming-Qing statecraft and evidential scholar; Record of Daily Knowledge opened Qing practical learning.

guan-zhong.oneLineEn: Spring and Autumn Qi statesman traditionally seen as pioneer of enriching the state and institutional governance.

han-yu.oneLineEn: Tang Confucian revivalist and Ancient Prose leader who restated the Confucian Way in Yuan Dao.
keywordsEn: Yuan Dao (On the Origin of the Way)

hu-hong.oneLineEn: Southern Song Huxiang School figure whose Understanding Words treats nature-substance and cultivation.

huang-zongxi.oneLineEn: Ming-Qing thinker-historian known for critique of monarchy and for Confucian intellectual history writing.

huiyuan.oneLineEn: Eastern Jin Mount Lu monk influential on monastic independence, Pure Land faith, and Buddhist community.
keywordsEn: Monks Should Not Bow to Kings

ji-kang.oneLineEn: Wei-Jin xuanxue figure known for nature, music theory, and nourishing life.
keywordsEn: Seven Sages of the Bamboo Grove
Music Has Neither Grief nor Joy

jiao-xun.oneLineEn: Qing classicist and mathematician known for Mencius studies, Yijing learning, and logical analysis.

jizang.oneLineEn: Sui-Tang Three Treatise master known for Madhyamaka two truths and refuting error to reveal the right.

le-quy-don.oneLineEn: Early modern Vietnamese Confucian-encyclopedist joining Neo-Confucianism and natural knowledge in Categorized Sayings.
keywordsEn: Categorized Sayings of the Cloud Terrace

ledi-sayadaw.oneLineEn: Burmese Theravada Abhidhamma and vipassana revivalist who popularized doctrine and practice via plain manuals.

leo-tolstoy.oneLineEn: Russian writer-thinker organizing social thought around Christian ethics, nonviolence, and conscience critique.
keywordsEn: The Kingdom of God Is Within You

lev-shestov.oneLineEn: Russian religious existentialist who, in Athens and Jerusalem, opposed rational necessity to freedom of faith.

li-si.oneLineEn: Core Qin empire institution-builder joining Xunzi learning with Legalist governance.

li-zhi.oneLineEn: Late Ming thinker known for the childlike mind, critique of false Dao Learning, and personal sincerity.

liu-xiang.oneLineEn: Western Han classicist, cataloger, and story compiler who reorganized texts and Confucian political memory.
